notes:
Config editor: key bindings now save correctly.

Capturing a key used to save the character you typed rather than the key's real name, so a number key was saved as "1" instead of "Alpha1" and the game couldn't read it ("8" even came out as Backspace, and Shift+1 as "!"). It now saves the physical key with the name Valheim expects: number row, letters, keypad, F-keys and punctuation.

MiniQoL 2.7.3 also repairs any bindings that were saved the old way.
